    window.addEventListener('load', function () {
        $(document).ready(function () {
            let btnLogin = $('#login_form .login-form__submit');
            let loginFormInput = $('#login_form .form-control');
            let popoverTriggerSearch = new bootstrap.Popover('.js-show-general-search');
            const demoEl = document.querySelector('.js-show-demo');
            if (demoEl) new bootstrap.Popover(demoEl);

            loginFormInput.blur(function () {
                if ($(this).val().trim() == '') {
                    $(this).addClass('is-invalid');
                    $(this).siblings('.invalid-feedback').addClass('d-block');
                } else {
                    $(this).removeClass('is-invalid')
                    $(this).siblings('.invalid-feedback').removeClass('d-block');
                }
            });

            btnLogin.click(function (e){
                let loginFormInput = $('#login_form .form-control');

                $.each(loginFormInput, function(elem) {
                    if ($(loginFormInput[elem]).prop('required') && $(loginFormInput[elem]).val().trim() == '') {
                        $(loginFormInput[elem]).addClass('is-invalid')
                    }
                })

                let invalidFeedback = $('#login_form .is-invalid');

                if (invalidFeedback.length != 0) {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    e.stopPropagation();
                }
            })

            let btnSearch = $('.js-show-general-search');

            btnSearch.on('click', function (e) {
                event.preventDefault();
                hideSearchPopover();
                positionGeneralSearch();
                showGeneralSearch();
                $('.js-search-word').focus();
            })

            function hideSearchPopover() {
                popoverTriggerSearch.hide();
            }

            $('.js-btn-close').on('click', function (e) {
                showGeneralSearch();
                $('.js-search-word').blur();
            })

            function showGeneralSearch() {
                $('.js-panel-general-search').toggleClass('show');
            }

            function positionGeneralSearch() {
                let panelGeneralSearch = $('.js-panel-general-search');

                if (window.innerWidth > 991) {
                    let positionMiddleBtn = btnSearch.position().left + (btnSearch.outerWidth() / 2);
                    let positionGeneralSearch = positionMiddleBtn - (panelGeneralSearch.outerWidth() / 2);
                    positionGeneralSearch = positionGeneralSearch + 'px';
                    panelGeneralSearch.css({'left': positionGeneralSearch});
                } else {
                    panelGeneralSearch.removeAttr("style");
                }
            }
        })
    })
